why: I checked verifier Check 4 against both must_not items. It does not silently PASS: it asks for evidence and reports FAIL when the PR is not merged, so item 2 is avoided. Item 1 is broken. Check 4 says to "fetch the page (`curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/`) and search it for `--shout`", then gives "PASS: the PR is merged and the fetched published page lists --shout" and "FAIL: the fetched page does not list --shout." That is a pass/fail on what the live page shows today. The merge-status gate doesn't fix this: the result still depends on the live site, not on the PR head the verifier is meant to check. Line 4 should have been treated as a post-merge item that can't be checked yet. Instead it is judged by fetching the live page. The builder brief is fine here, since it only notes that line 4 is confirmed after merge.
